title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
script:
European retailers are using NVIDIA accelerated open models to transform their digital and physical operations.
A commerce platform using these models cut its inference costs by ninety percent.
Retailers are also simulating entire fulfillment centers inside a digital twin to manage robotic fleets.
This setup allows for the collaboration of different robotic fleets working in the same physical space.
Companies use these accelerated models to improve efficiency across their retail backend systems.
Would you trust a robot to pick your groceries?
